'''House Pthen''' was a guild active in [[Depatar/Legends|Depatar]], a [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Genarius]]. The [[permitor]] [[Koyi Kobad]] was affiliated to this house, apparently trying to direct customers to business also affiliated to the house &mdash; which were probably luxury places.
